+++ b/qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py

+            QProcess.Crashed: 'crashed',
+            QProcess.Timedout: 'timed out',
+            QProcess.WriteError: 'write error',
+            QProcess.ReadError: 'read error',
+        }
+        detail = self._proc.errorString()
+        msg = "{} '{}' {}: {}".format(
+            self._what.capitalize(), self.cmd,
+            descriptions.get(error, 'error'), detail)
+        if (error == QProcess.FailedToStart and not utils.is_windows and
+                detail.endswith(('No such file or directory',

+            msg += " (Hint: Make sure '{}' exists and is executable)".format(
+                self.cmd)
+        message.error(msg)

diff --git a/tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py b/tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py
index 9e1b391..318d99e 100644
--- a/tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py
+++ b/tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py
@@ -226,7 +226,58 @@ def test_error(qtbot, proc, caplog, message_mock):
             proc.start('this_does_not_exist_either', [])
 
     msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
-    assert msg.text.startswith("Error while spawning testprocess:")
+    assert msg.text.startswith(
+        "Testprocess 'this_does_not_exist_either' failed to start: ")
+    if not utils.is_windows:
+        assert msg.text.endswith(
+            "(Hint: Make sure 'this_does_not_exist_either' exists and is "
+            "executable)")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('error, description', [
+    (QProcess.FailedToStart, 'failed to start'),
+    (QProcess.Crashed, 'crashed'),
+    (QProcess.Timedout, 'timed out'),
+    (QProcess.WriteError, 'write error'),
+    (QProcess.ReadError, 'read error'),
+])
+def test_error_description(fake_proc, monkeypatch, message_mock, caplog, error,
+                           description):
+    """Each QProcess error has a useful description and the command."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', True)
+    fake_proc.cmd = 'missing-command'
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = 'process detail'
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(error)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == (
+        "Testprocess 'missing-command' {}: process detail".format(
+            description))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('detail, hint', [
+    ('No such file or directory', True),
+    ('execvp: No such file or directory', True),
+    ('Permission denied', True),
+    ('Other error', False),
+])
+def test_start_error_hint(fake_proc, monkeypatch, message_mock, caplog, detail,
+                          hint):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', False)
+    fake_proc.cmd = 'missing-command'
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = detail
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(QProcess.FailedToStart)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    expected = "Testprocess 'missing-command' failed to start: " + detail
+    if hint:
+        expected += (" (Hint: Make sure 'missing-command' exists and is "
+                     "executable)")
+    assert msg.text == expected
